source.site: catalog.json 人教版高中 真实单元目录；知识点/题目复用 knowledge/english 通用池

units.name: 第4单元·Journey Across a Vast Land

topics.name: 科学研究
topics.description: 认读 hypothesis、experiment、data 和 evidence。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「假设」？
example.answer: hypothesis

topics.name: 科学结论
topics.description: 认读 conclude、variable、sample 和 method。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「得出结论」？
example.answer: conclude

topics.name: 虚拟语气
topics.description: 能用 If I were 和 would 加原形表达与现在事实相反的假设。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 与现在事实相反：如果我是你，我会先核对数据。哪一句正确？
example.answer: If I were you, I would check the data

topics.name: but for 与虚拟
topics.description: 能用 But for 表示“要不是”，并搭配 would have done 或 would do。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 要不是你的帮助，我当时就会失败。哪一句正确？
example.answer: But for your help, I would have failed

topics.name: 说明科学假设
topics.description: 能说明假设、证据和还不能确定的地方。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说如果有更多证据就会更确定，哪一句合适？
example.answer: If we had more evidence, we would be more certain

topics.name: 读科学短文
topics.description: 找出论点、还缺少的证据，以及作者没有直接说满的限度。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: If the team had a larger sample, they would trust the result more. But for one failed experiment, they would have published the paper last month. The data are useful, but they do not prove the whole hypothesis. 样本更大的话，他们会怎样？
example.answer: 更信任这个结果

topics.name: 写实验评论
topics.description: 能按要点选出评论中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：样本更大就会更信任、要不是失败实验上个月会发表、数据还不能证明全部假设。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: If they had a larger sample they would trust it more, but for the failed experiment they would have published, and the data do not prove the whole hypothesis

topics.name: 跨文化交流
topics.description: 认读 exchange、abroad、adapt 和 homesick。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「交流」？
example.answer: exchange

topics.name: 寄宿家庭
topics.description: 认读 host、custom、misunderstand 和 fluent。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「主人」？
example.answer: host

topics.name: 与过去事实相反的虚拟
topics.description: 能在从句用 had done，在主句用 would have done。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 如果我当时更努力适应，我就会少一些误会。哪一句正确？
example.answer: If I had adapted faster, I would have had fewer misunderstandings

topics.name: 错综时间虚拟
topics.description: 能在从句指过去、主句指现在时，分别使用 had done 和 would do。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 如果当时听了主人的建议，我现在就会更流利。哪一句正确？
example.answer: If I had followed the advice, I would be more fluent now

topics.name: 比较文化差异
topics.description: 能比较习俗差异，并说明如果当时知道就会怎样。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说如果当时问了主人就不会误会，哪一句合适？
example.answer: If I had asked my host, I would not have misunderstood the custom

topics.name: 读交流短文
topics.description: 推断当时发生了什么，以及现在还剩下什么感受。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: If Lin had asked her host, she would not have worn the wrong clothes to the dinner. If she had known that custom, she would feel less embarrassed now. She is still learning, and her host is patient. 如果当时问了主人，她就不会怎样？
example.answer: 穿错衣服去吃饭

topics.name: 写交流反思
topics.description: 能按要点选出反思中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：当时问了就不会穿错、知道习俗现在会少些尴尬、主人有耐心。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: If I had asked I would not have worn the wrong clothes, if I had known the custom I would feel less embarrassed now, and my host is patient

topics.name: 饮食文化
topics.description: 认读 recipe、ingredient、flavour 和 appetite。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「食谱」？
example.answer: recipe

topics.name: 餐桌礼仪
topics.description: 认读 spice、banquet、chopstick 和 manner。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「香料」？
example.answer: spice

topics.name: 与将来事实相反的虚拟
topics.description: 能用 should、were to 加原形表示与将来事实相反的假设。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 万一明天的宴会取消，我们就会在家吃。哪一句正确？
example.answer: If the banquet should be cancelled, we would eat at home

topics.name: as if 虚拟
topics.description: 能在 as if 后面用过去式或 had done，表示好像并非事实。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 他谈起这道菜，好像自己是厨师。与现在不符，哪一句正确？
example.answer: He talks as if he were a cook

topics.name: 比较饮食
topics.description: 能比较不同菜肴，并说明自己的口味。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说这道菜好像没有放盐，哪一句合适？
example.answer: This dish tastes as if it had no salt

topics.name: 读饮食短文
topics.description: 推断 as if 暗示的真实情况，以及还没发生的打算。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: The banquet included a mild soup and a spicy fish. Lin ate as if she had never tasted that spice. If the fish should be too hot, she would drink some soup. 宴会上有什么？
example.answer: 清淡的汤和辣鱼

topics.name: 写饮食说明
topics.description: 能按要点选出说明中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：有汤和辣鱼、她好像没尝过这种香料、太辣就喝汤。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: There was soup and spicy fish, she ate as if she had never tasted the spice, and if it should be too hot she would drink soup

topics.name: 长途旅行
topics.unit_name: 第4单元·Journey Across a Vast Land
topics.description: 认读 rail、carriage、scenery 和 delay。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「铁路」？
example.answer: rail

topics.name: 旅途见闻
topics.unit_name: 第4单元·Journey Across a Vast Land
topics.description: 认读 boundless、frost、awesome 和 cross。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「一望无际的」？
example.answer: boundless

topics.name: wish 虚拟
topics.unit_name: 第4单元·Journey Across a Vast Land
topics.description: 能在 wish 后面用过去式表示与现在相反，用 had done 表示与过去相反。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 我希望我现在就在那列火车上，但事实上不在。哪一句正确？
example.answer: I wish I were on that train

topics.name: if only 虚拟
topics.unit_name: 第4单元·Journey Across a Vast Land
topics.description: 能用 If only 加过去式或 had done 表示强烈愿望。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 要是现在能看见那片一望无际的平原就好了。哪一句正确？
example.answer: If only I could see the boundless plain

topics.name: 用语调表达态度
topics.unit_name: 第4单元·Journey Across a Vast Land
topics.description: 能判断升调、降调或重读是在表示犹豫、惊讶还是强调。
mastery_criteria: 能根据重音、语调或音变选出正确的一项
能说明这个朗读规则用在什么地方

example.question: Really? 用明显的升调，更可能表示什么？
example.answer: 惊讶

topics.name: 描述旅途
topics.unit_name: 第4单元·Journey Across a Vast Land
topics.description: 能描述沿途风景，并表达遗憾或愿望。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说希望自己现在就在车上，哪一句合适？
example.answer: I wish I were on the train

topics.name: 读旅途短文
topics.unit_name: 第4单元·Journey Across a Vast Land
topics.description: 推断 Lin 后悔的是什么，以及哪一句只是愿望。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: The train crossed a boundless plain at dawn. Lin wishes she had sat by the window, because she missed the frost. If only the delay had been shorter. 火车黎明时穿越了什么？
example.answer: 一望无际的平原

topics.name: 写旅途邮件
topics.unit_name: 第4单元·Journey Across a Vast Land
topics.description: 能按要点选出邮件中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：黎明穿越平原、后悔没坐窗边、希望延误更短。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: We crossed a plain at dawn, I wish I had sat by the window, and if only the delay had been shorter

topics.name: 急救
topics.description: 认读 first aid、bleed、bandage 和 choke。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「急救」？
example.answer: first aid

topics.name: 伤情处理
topics.description: 认读 wound、swelling、pressure 和 ambulance。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「伤口」？
example.answer: wound

topics.name: 建议命令的虚拟
topics.description: 能在 suggest、insist、order 后面用 should 加原形，should 可以省略。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 医生建议她休息。哪一句正确？
example.answer: The doctor suggested that she should rest

topics.name: otherwise 虚拟
topics.description: 能用 otherwise 表示如果不这样就，并搭配 would have done。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: 他当时在流血，不然他就不会叫救护车。哪一句正确？
example.answer: He was bleeding; otherwise he would not have called an ambulance

topics.name: 说明急救步骤
topics.description: 能按步骤说明止血，并建议何时叫救护车。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想按步骤说先按压伤口，哪一句合适？
example.answer: First, put pressure on the wound

topics.name: 读急救短文
topics.description: 找出已经做的步骤、建议，以及 otherwise 排除的结果。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: The coach suggested that the student sit down. He put pressure on the wound and then used a bandage. Otherwise the bleeding would have become dangerous. An ambulance arrived ten minutes later. 教练建议学生做什么？
example.answer: 坐下

topics.name: 写急救步骤
topics.description: 能按要点选出步骤说明中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：建议坐下、按压并包扎、否则流血会危险。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: The coach suggested that he sit down, pressure and a bandage were used, and otherwise the bleeding would have become dangerous

questions.subject: english

questions.explain: hypothesis 的意思是假设。

questions.explain: conclude 的意思是得出结论。

questions.explain: variable 的意思是变量。

questions.stem: 选择表示「样本」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示样本的单词是 sample。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「方法」？
questions.explain: method 的意思是方法。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 与现在事实相反：如果我是你，我会先核对数据。哪一句正确？
questions.explain: 与现在相反，从句用 were，主句用 would 加原形。
options: If I were you, I would check the data
If I am you, I would check the data
If I were you, I will check the data
If I were you, I checked the data

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: If she ___ more evidence, she would be more certain. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 与现在相反的从句用过去式 had。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句是与现在事实相反的虚拟？
questions.explain: knew 配 would help，表示现在并不知道。
options: If he knows the method, he will help us
If he knew the method, he helps us
If he knew the method, he would help us
If he knows the method, he would help us

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: If I ___ a larger sample, I would trust the result. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 从句用 had，主句用 would trust。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 要不是你的帮助，我当时就会失败。哪一句正确？
questions.explain: 与过去相反用 would have failed。
options: But for your help, I failed
But for your help, I would have failed
But for your help, I would fail yesterday
But for your help, I had failed

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: But for the evidence, we ___ still unsure. 表示现在仍会不确定，横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 说的是现在的结果，用 would be。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句用 but for 表示与过去相反？
questions.explain: would have chosen 是与过去相反的结果。
options: But for the experiment, they chose the wrong method
But for the experiment, they will choose
But for the experiment, they had chose
But for the experiment, they would have chosen the wrong method

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: But for 在这种句子里更接近哪一个意思？
questions.explain: But for your help 意思是如果没有你的帮助。
options: 因为有了所以真实发生

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想说如果有更多证据就会更确定，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 与现在相反用 had 配 would be。
options: If we have more evidence, we would be more certain
If we had more evidence, we are more certain
If we had more evidence, we would be more certain
If we would have more evidence, we are certain

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想说要不是那次实验，结论就会不同，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: But for 加 would be 表示假如没有。
options: But for that experiment, the conclusion is different in the past wish
Would be the conclusion but for real
But for that experiment, the conclusion would be different

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想指出数据还不够，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: are not enough to support 用来限定结论。
options: The data are not enough to support the hypothesis
The data are not enough to support the hypothessis
The data are not enough to supporting the hypothesis
The data are not enough support the hypothesis

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想建议先控制变量，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: should control 用来提出下一步。
options: We should control the variables first
We should controlled the variables first
We should to control the variables first

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: If the team had a larger sample, they would trust the result more. But for one failed experiment, they would have published the paper last month. The data are useful, but they do not prove the whole hypothesis. 样本更大的话，他们会怎样？
questions.explain: would trust the result more 是假设的结果。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: If the team had a larger sample, they would trust the result more. But for one failed experiment, they would have published the paper last month. The data are useful, but they do not prove the whole hypothesis. 要不是那次失败的实验，他们上个月会怎样？
questions.explain: would have published the paper last month。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: If the team had a larger sample, they would trust the result more. But for one failed experiment, they would have published the paper last month. The data are useful, but they do not prove the whole hypothesis. 数据现在能证明什么？
questions.explain: 短文写 do not prove the whole hypothesis。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: If the team had a larger sample, they would trust the result more. But for one failed experiment, they would have published the paper last month. The data are useful, but they do not prove the whole hypothesis. 作者的论点更接近哪一种？
questions.explain: useful, but they do not prove 是在限定论点。
options: 实验失败所以数据无用
数据有用，但还不足以证明全部假设

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 要点：样本更大就会更信任、要不是失败实验上个月会发表、数据还不能证明全部假设。哪一句三个要点都有？
questions.explain: 三个要点都要出现。
options: If they had a larger sample they would trust it more, but for the failed experiment they would have published, and the data do not prove the whole hypothesis

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 评论里表示与现在相反，哪一句正确？
questions.explain: were 配 would repeat。
options: If I am on the team, I would repeat the test
If I were on the team, I would repeat the test
If I were on the team, I will repeat the test
If I were on the team, I repeated the test

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句适合作为评论的第一句？
questions.explain: 评论可以先写出限度 not fully proved。
options: The hypothesis is interest but not fully proved
The hypothesis are interesting but not fully proved
The hypothesis is interesting but not fully proved
The hypothesis is interested but not fully proved

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句用 But for 谈过去？
questions.explain: would have finished 对应过去。
options: But for the error, they finished
But for the error, they finish tomorrow
But for the error, they had finish
But for the error, they would have finished

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「交流」？
questions.explain: exchange 的意思是交流。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 「abroad」的中文意思是哪一个？
questions.explain: abroad 的意思是在国外。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 选择表示「适应」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示适应的单词是 adapt。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「想家的」？
questions.explain: homesick 的意思是想家的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「主人」？
questions.explain: host 的意思是主人。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 「custom」的中文意思是哪一个？
questions.explain: custom 的意思是习俗。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 选择表示「误解」的单词。
